description: Long-form prose body rendered from a compact tuple-array block schema (['h2', ...], ['p', segs], ['table', ...], etc.) with a real, statute-cited employment-compliance guide as content. Distinct from content.blog-post-body's object-based block schema — the two are not shared/unified in this codebase.
scope: Present on all 11 compliance-country routes and all 3 legal routes (privacy/terms/dpa) — 14 route occurrences, one shared Prose renderer.

blocks.note: the tuple-array DSL: each block is [tag, content], not an object. See asset-role document.regulatory-prose for compliance-country content; legal docs are their own real content, also must-not-fabricate.
